verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM. Its docs say admins can confirm devices are managed, see each device's security posture, and enforce settings, with a one-click secure baseline for macOS and Windows and Apple ADE enrollment for Macs. That covers the core of tracking workstation compliance through an MDM. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the specific checks (disk encryption, screen lock, password manager), explicit per-employee compliance mapping or reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
